defects.claim_says: The EO 14131 events on sections 2, 4 and 6 (EO 14131 section 2(b), 2(c) and 2(d)) cite a 334-character quoted span of EO_14131.txt.
defects.source_says: That span contains only the lead-in ('Executive Order 11926 ... is further amended by:') and '(a) Amending section 1 to read as follows: ''Section 1 .'. Subsections 2(b) (restating section 2), 2(c) (restating section 4) and 2(d) (restating section 6), which follow in the held file, are not in the quoted evidence, so the evidence attached to those three events does not show the amendment each is cited for.
